output.question: What is CDW's annual revenue?
output.answer: CDW Corporation's latest reported full-year revenue was $22,424.1 million (about $22.42 billion) for the year ended December 31, 2025, up 6.8% from 2024. CDW reports revenue as net sales; its newer results cover only the nine months ended September 30, 2026, not a complete fiscal year.

key_facts.fact: CDW reported annual net sales of $22,424.1 million for the year ended December 31, 2025, an increase of 6.8% over 2024.
The newer earnings release, published November 4, 2026, covers the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026.

passages.quote: Net sales in 2025 were $22,424 million, compared to $20,999 million in 2024, an increase of 6.8 percent.

caveats: Annual revenue here means the latest completed fiscal year, not trailing-twelve-month revenue or an annualized interim figure.
